observation.command: echo "=== pnpm store / cache ==="; ls -la ~/.pnpm-store 2>/dev/null | head; du -sh ~/.local/share/pnpm 2>/dev/null; du -sh /workspace/app/node_modules 2>/dev/null; echo "=== network test to npm (3 quick curls) ==="; for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "attempt $i: http=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" --max-time 20 "https://registry.npmjs.org/@firebase%2Fauth-types" ; done
